item_title: Some CSOs say ex-Uber CSO Joe Sullivan did nothing wrong and his trial tests criminal penalties they may face over security lapses or challenges in gray areas
item_description: Robert McMillan / Wall Street Journal:  — Joe Sullivan, a former federal prosecutor, is accused of helping to cover up a security breach, a charge he denies

item_title: Mint Mobile, US Mobile, and Boost Mobile say eSIM as the only option for US iPhone 14 models “democratizes connectivity” by letting users easily switch carriers
item_description: Eli Blumenthal / CNET:  — Mint Mobile, Boost Mobile and US Mobile see room for growth as eSIM technology could make switching networks even easier.

item_title: Roblox CEO says the company has 2M+ DAUs in Russia, as rivals EA, Nintendo, Take-Two, Epic, Ubisoft, Microsoft, and Sony slowed or ceased sales in the country
item_description: Cecilia D'Anastasio / Bloomberg: Roblox CEO says the company has 2M+ DAUs in Russia, as rivals EA, Nintendo, Take-Two, Epic, Ubisoft, Microsoft, and Sony slowed or ceased sales in the country — Roblox Corp.'s popularity in Russia is increasing even as almost every other publicly traded gaming company has retreated from the country after its invasion of Ukraine.
